cds.title: Washington State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set, fall 2025 first-year class. The Common Data Set's enrollment tables are WSU systemwide: 21,400 undergraduates including the Pullman, Vancouver, Tri-Cities, Everett and Global campuses, of whom 483 are nonresident (international) students; the student-faculty ratio is 14:1. The Common Data Set did not report SAT/ACT percentiles, so no score ranges are shown. Only 6.24% of enrollees submitted SAT and 1.11% ACT. No early decision or early action; no waitlist policy.

cds_test_policy.notes: WSU's first-year admissions page says it does not require SAT/ACT scores and will not use them in admission decisions; the Common Data Set marks standardized test scores 'not considered'.

cost.notes: Tuition and fees are from the Common Data Set (2026-27); other costs are transportation $1,716 plus personal $1,968. The total cost of attendance shown is WSU International Programs' estimate for an international undergraduate for fall plus spring (tuition and fees $33,087, books $900, medical insurance $4,290, living $17,246, other $3,684; page does not name the year). The Common Data Set says only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 216 nonresident undergraduates received it (avg $10,094)
